description.en:
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance

Press Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance

Press Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance

Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance

Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance

Tekan Normal Attack berulang kali atau tahan untuk mengonsumsi Melody dan melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan Havoc DMG. Selama Melody belum habis, Energy Regen meningkat sebesar 20% saat Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance memberikan damage.
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Tahap 4 menimpakan 1 stack Havoc Bane pada target yang terkena.

Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance

Tekan Normal Attack berulang kali atau tahan untuk mengonsumsi Melody dan melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan Havoc DMG. Selama Melody belum habis, Energy Regen meningkat sebesar 20% saat Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance memberikan damage.
Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Tahap 4 menimpakan 1 stack Havoc Bane pada target yang terkena.

Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, mengonsumsi Melody dan memberikan Havoc DMG.
Menekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan skill ini memicu Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Tahap 2.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, mengonsumsi Melody dan memberikan Havoc DMG.
Menekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan skill ini memicu Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance

Menekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah Dodge berhasil mengonsumsi Melody untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Menekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan skill ini memicu Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Tahap 3.
Melancarkan Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance dihitung sebagai melancarkan Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance

Menekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah Dodge berhasil mengonsumsi Melody untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Menekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan skill ini memicu Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Tahap 3.
Melancarkan Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance dihitung sebagai melancarkan Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Tahap 2.

description.en:
Sword Stance Switch

While in Azure Sword Stance, press Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

While in Feather Sword Stance, press Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

Sword Stance Switch: Azure

Press Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

Sword Stance Switch: Feather

Press Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.
description.id:
Sword Stance Switch

Saat dalam Azure Sword Stance, tekan Resonance Skill untuk berganti ke Feather Sword Stance dan melakukan Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Tahap 1, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Saat dalam Feather Sword Stance, tekan Resonance Skill untuk berganti ke Azure Sword Stance dan melakukan Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Tahap 1, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Sword Stance Switch: Azure

Tekan Resonance Skill dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance untuk berganti ke Azure Sword Stance dan melancarkan Sword Stance Switch: Azure, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.
Dodge yang berhasil dapat dipicu dalam waktu singkat selama aksi skill ini, yang mengonsumsi 50 Melody.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, siklus Basic Attack tidak akan direset untuk waktu singkat.

Sword Stance Switch: Feather

Tekan Resonance Skill dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance untuk berganti ke Feather Sword Stance dan melancarkan Sword Stance Switch: Feather, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.
Dodge yang berhasil dapat dipicu dalam waktu singkat selama aksi skill ini, yang mengonsumsi 50 Melody.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, siklus Basic Attack tidak akan direset untuk waktu singkat.

description.en:
Hush of a Thousand Voices

Consume all Melody to deal Havoc DMG and restore 1 point of Azure Plume. This DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Upon casting this skill, obtain Voice upon Voice. When casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, summon Shadow of Xuanling to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Voice upon Voice cannot stack. Once Shadow of Xuanling is summoned, the Voice upon Voice state is removed.
description.id:
Hush of a Thousand Voices

Mengonsumsi seluruh Melody untuk memberikan Havoc DMG dan memulihkan 1 poin Azure Plume. DMG ini dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.

Saat melancarkan skill ini, mendapatkan Voice upon Voice. Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure atau Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, memanggil Shadow of Xuanling untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.
Voice upon Voice tidak dapat ditumpuk. Setelah Shadow of Xuanling dipanggil, kondisi Voice upon Voice dihapus.

description.en:
When a target has 1 to 3 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack of Havoc Bane Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by 10%, up to 30%.

When a target has 4 to 6 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack of Havoc Bane Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by 12%, up to 36%.
description.id:
Saat target memiliki 1 hingga 3 stack Havoc Bane, setiap stack Havoc Bane memberikan Amplify pada DMG dari Yangyang: Xuanling sebesar 10%, hingga 30%.

Saat target memiliki 4 hingga 6 stack Havoc Bane, setiap stack Havoc Bane memberikan Amplify pada DMG dari Yangyang: Xuanling sebesar 12%, hingga 36%.

description.en:
Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices raises the Havoc Bane stacks on the targets to the maximum on hit.

When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Windbound. Windbound can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times.

When Windbound reaches 6 stacks, Yangyang: Xuanling removes all Windbound and gains One with the Wind.
While One with the Wind lasts, when Yangyang: Xuanling casts Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, she summons Feather Release: Xuanling to attack the target, applying 6 stacks of Havoc Bane to the target.
Windbound cannot be obtained while One with the Wind lasts.

Once Feather Release: Xuanling is summoned, the One with the Wind state is removed.
description.id:
Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices menaikkan stack Havoc Bane pada target hingga maksimum saat mengenai.

Saat Resonator di tim yang berada di dekat menimpakan Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling mendapat 1 stack Windbound. Windbound dapat diperoleh sekali setiap 1 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 6 kali.

Saat Windbound mencapai 6 stack, Yangyang: Xuanling menghapus semua Windbound dan mendapatkan One with the Wind.
Selama One with the Wind aktif, saat Yangyang: Xuanling melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure atau Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, ia memanggil Feather Release: Xuanling untuk menyerang target, menimpakan 6 stack Havoc Bane pada target.
Windbound tidak dapat diperoleh selama One with the Wind aktif.

Setelah Feather Release: Xuanling dipanggil, kondisi One with the Wind dihapus.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure

Yangyang: Xuanling is in Azure Sword Stance by default. When Melody is depleted while in Feather Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure.
Press Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 points of Melody and 1 points of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure hits the target, consume 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather

When Melody is depleted while in Azure Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather.
Press Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 points of Melody and 1 points of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather hits, consume 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance

When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Azure Sword Stance, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, gain Bated Breath: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance increases by 160%. When Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance ends, Bated Breath is removed. Bated Breath can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance applies 2 stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance

When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, dealing Havoc DMG. After it hits a target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall is automatically cast.
When casting Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, gain Streaming Storm, which lasts 15s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance or the next Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom is increased by 160%. Streaming Storm is removed when Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 ends. Streaming Storm can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance applies 2 stacks stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall

When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance and airborne, Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall.
Press or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall enters Hark the Wind for 12s.

Hark the Wind

While in Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During Hark the Wind, a Dodge Counter counts towards the Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle.

Feathered Oath

When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane on a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Feathered Oath for 4s. Feathered Oath can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom by 25%, up to 150%.

Refrain

Before Yangyang: Xuanling's Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, or Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of Havoc Bane on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.

Melody

Melody has a maximum of 100 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather restores 100 points of Melody.
Casting Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices consumes all Melody.
Normal Attacks consumes Melody upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Azure Plume

Azure Plume has a maximum of 2 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, or Intro Skill - Skybound Feather restores 1 point of Azure Plume.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices restores 1 point of Azure Plume.
Casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance or Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall consumes all Azure Plume.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure

Yangyang: Xuanling berada dalam Azure Sword Stance secara default. Saat Melody habis dalam Feather Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge digantikan oleh Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure.
Tekan Resonance Skill untuk berganti ke Azure Sword Stance dan melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, memberikan Havoc DMG dan memulihkan 100 poin Melody dan 1 poin Azure Plume. DMG ini dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.
Saat Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure mengenai target, mengonsumsi 1 stack Havoc Bane pada target.
Siklus Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance tidak direset dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure. Jika melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure mereset siklus, memanggil Wraith of Sound untuk menyelesaikan serangan saat ini dan memberikan satu instance Havoc DMG tetap, dianggap Basic Attack DMG, yang tidak dipengaruhi efek DMG Bonus apa pun dan tidak menimpakan Havoc Bane.
Dodge yang berhasil dapat dipicu dalam waktu singkat selama aksi skill ini, yang mengonsumsi 50 poin Melody.

Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather

Saat Melody habis dalam Azure Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge digantikan oleh Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather.
Tekan Resonance Skill untuk berganti ke Feather Sword Stance dan melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, memberikan Havoc DMG dan memulihkan 100 poin Melody dan 1 poin Azure Plume. DMG ini dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.
Saat Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather mengenai target, mengonsumsi 1 stack Havoc Bane pada target.
Siklus Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance tidak direset dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather. Jika melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather mereset siklus, memanggil Wraith of Sound untuk menyelesaikan serangan saat ini dan memberikan satu instance Havoc DMG tetap, dianggap Basic Attack DMG, yang tidak dipengaruhi efek DMG Bonus apa pun dan tidak menimpakan Havoc Bane.
Dodge yang berhasil dapat dipicu dalam waktu singkat selama aksi skill ini, yang mengonsumsi 50 poin Melody.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance

Saat Azure Plume dipulihkan hingga maksimum dalam Azure Sword Stance, tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi STA dan seluruh Azure Plume untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, menghasilkan siklon besar yang menghantam area di depan, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, mendapatkan Bated Breath: Jika Yangyang: Xuanling adalah Resonator aktif di lapangan, Crit. DMG Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance ini meningkat sebesar 160%. Saat Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance berakhir, Bated Breath dihapus. Bated Breath dapat diperoleh paling banyak sekali setiap 25 dtk.
Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance menimpakan 2 stack Havoc Bane pada target yang terkena.

Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance

Saat Azure Plume dipulihkan hingga maksimum dalam Feather Sword Stance, jika Yangyang: Xuanling berada di tanah dan tidak dalam siklus Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi STA dan melancarkan Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, memberikan Havoc DMG. Setelah mengenai target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall otomatis dilancarkan.
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, mendapatkan Streaming Storm, yang bertahan selama 15 dtk. Selama Yangyang: Xuanling adalah Resonator aktif di tim, Crit. DMG Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance ini atau Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, atau Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom berikutnya meningkat sebesar 160%. Streaming Storm dihapus saat Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Tahap 3 atau Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom Tahap 3 berakhir. Streaming Storm dapat diperoleh paling banyak sekali setiap 25 dtk.
Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance menimpakan 2 stack Havoc Bane pada target yang terkena.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall

Saat Azure Plume dipulihkan hingga maksimum dalam Feather Sword Stance dan berada di udara, Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance digantikan oleh Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi STA dan seluruh Azure Plume untuk melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG. Melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall memasuki Hark the Wind selama 12 dtk.

Hark the Wind

Saat dalam Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, yang melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG.
Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Tahap 2 dan Tahap 3 dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah. Melancarkan Tahap 3 mengakhiri Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. Siklus serangan ini tidak dapat direset.
Selama Hark the Wind, Dodge Counter dihitung sebagai bagian dari siklus Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom.

Feathered Oath

Saat Resonator di tim yang berada di dekat menimpakan Havoc Bane pada target, Yangyang: Xuanling mendapat 1 stack Feathered Oath selama 4 dtk. Feathered Oath dapat diperoleh sekali setiap 1 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 6 kali. Selama Yangyang: Xuanling adalah Resonator aktif di tim, setiap stack meningkatkan Crit. DMG Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, dan Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom sebesar 25%, hingga 150%.

Refrain

Sebelum Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Tahap 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Tahap 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, atau Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance Yangyang: Xuanling mengenai target, catat dan sebarkan jumlah stack Havoc Bane tertinggi pada target dalam jangkauan tertentu ke semua target dalam jangkauan.

Melody

Melody memiliki maksimum 100 poin.
Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure atau Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather memulihkan 100 poin Melody.
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices mengonsumsi seluruh Melody.
Normal Attack mengonsumsi Melody saat memberikan damage.
Dodge yang berhasil dapat dipicu selama aksi Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, atau Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather dalam waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan skill tersebut, yang mengonsumsi 50 poin Melody.

Azure Plume

Azure Plume memiliki maksimum 2 poin.
Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, atau Intro Skill - Skybound Feather memulihkan 1 poin Azure Plume.
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices memulihkan 1 poin Azure Plume.
Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance atau Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall mengonsumsi seluruh Azure Plume.

description.en:
The DMG dealt by Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom is increased by 100%.

Every time Yangyang: Xuanling remains out of combat for more than 4s after she leaves the combat state or revives, she gains the following effects once:
- Gain Strung Notes, up to 1 stack. Casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance or Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance summons Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 337.98% of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Strung Notes is removed after Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes is summoned.
- Restore 2 points of Azure Plume.
- Reset the Cooldown of gaining Bated Breath and Streaming Storm.
description.id:
DMG yang diberikan oleh Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, dan Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom meningkat sebesar 100%.

Setiap kali Yangyang: Xuanling tetap di luar pertempuran lebih dari 4 dtk setelah keluar dari kondisi pertempuran atau bangkit kembali, ia mendapat efek berikut satu kali:
- Mendapatkan Strung Notes, hingga 1 stack. Melancarkan Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance atau Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance memanggil Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG sebesar 337,98% ATK Yangyang: Xuanling, dianggap Heavy Attack DMG. Strung Notes dihapus setelah Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes dipanggil.
- Memulihkan 2 poin Azure Plume.
- Mereset Cooldown perolehan Bated Breath dan Streaming Storm.

sequences.name: My Grief Follows You into the Clouds

description.en:
The DMG dealt via Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices is Amplified by 175%.

After casting Intro Skill - Skybound Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, increase the maximum Havoc Bane stacks on targets within a certain range by 3, lasting 20s. This effect does not stack.

Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, and Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance inflict 1 additional stack of Havoc Bane on the target.
description.id:
DMG yang diberikan melalui Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices mendapat Amplify sebesar 175%.

Setelah melancarkan Intro Skill - Skybound Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, atau Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, meningkatkan stack Havoc Bane maksimum pada target dalam jangkauan tertentu sebanyak 3, selama 20 dtk. Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk.

Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Tahap 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Tahap 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, dan Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance menimpakan 1 stack Havoc Bane tambahan pada target.

sequences.name: Across the Miles, a Letter and My Longing

description.en: When casting Intro Skill - Skybound Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, the ATK of Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 20s.
description.id: Saat melancarkan Intro Skill - Skybound Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, atau Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, ATK Resonator di tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 20 dtk.

description.en: When Yangyang: Xuanling takes a fatal blow, she will not be downed, but instead recover HP equal to 50% of her Max HP while becoming immune to DMG and interruption for 3s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min.
description.id: Saat Yangyang: Xuanling menerima serangan fatal, ia tidak akan tumbang, melainkan memulihkan HP sebesar 50% Max HP-nya sambil kebal terhadap DMG dan interupsi selama 3 dtk. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 10 menit.

sequences.name: Let the Azure Keep Its Light

description.en:
After Yangyang: Xuanling inflicts Havoc Bane on a target, gain Voice Flux for 30s. While Voice Flux is active, targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling.

Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather grants Still as Withered Wood for 30s. While Still as Withered Wood is active, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the field, then after nearby Resonators in the team inflict Glacio Chafe, Fusion Burst, Electro Flare, Aero Erosion, Spectro Frazzle, or Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling summons Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 337.98% of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK. The DMG of Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood is considered Heavy Attack DMG and is guaranteed to be a critical hit.

Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood can be summoned once every 1s, and Still as Withered Wood expires after it is summoned 5 times. When Still as Withered Wood expires or is removed, reset the available summon charges of Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood. Still as Withered Wood has a Cooldown of 25s.
description.id:
Setelah Yangyang: Xuanling menimpakan Havoc Bane pada target, mendapatkan Voice Flux selama 30 dtk. Selama Voice Flux aktif, target menerima 40% lebih banyak Heavy Attack DMG dari Yangyang: Xuanling.

Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure atau Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather memberikan Still as Withered Wood selama 30 dtk. Selama Still as Withered Wood aktif, jika Yangyang: Xuanling berada di lapangan, maka setelah Resonator di tim yang berada di dekat menimpakan Glacio Chafe, Fusion Burst, Electro Flare, Aero Erosion, Spectro Frazzle, atau Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling memanggil Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG sebesar 337,98% ATK Yangyang: Xuanling. DMG Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood dianggap Heavy Attack DMG dan dijamin critical hit.

Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood dapat dipanggil sekali setiap 1 dtk, dan Still as Withered Wood berakhir setelah dipanggil 5 kali. Saat Still as Withered Wood berakhir atau dihapus, reset charge pemanggilan Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood yang tersedia. Still as Withered Wood memiliki Cooldown 25 dtk.
